lines.beaver_en: Oh, Minho! It's been so long.
lines.learner: 지수 씨, 오랜만이에요. 인상이 많이 달라졌네요!
lines.en: Jisu, long time no see. You look so different!
lines.roman: jisu ssi, oraenmanieyo. insangi mani dallajyeonneyo!

lines.beaver_en: Really? I had my hair done.
lines.en: With your hair done, you look really elegant.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. I changed my makeup a little too.
lines.learner: 속눈썹도 길어 보이고 눈빛이 정말 매력 있어요.
lines.en: Your eyelashes look long, and your eyes are really charming.
lines.roman: songnunsseopdo gireo boigo nunbichi jeongmal maeryeok isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 요즘 외모에 신경을 좀 쓰고 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: I've been paying attention to my looks lately.
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum oemoe singyeongeul jom sseugo isseoyo.
lines.learner: 꾸미는 걸 좋아한다더니 정말 잘 꾸몄네요.
lines.en: You said you like dressing up, and you really did it well.
lines.roman: kkumineun geol joahandadeoni jeongmal jal kkumyeonneyo.

lines.beaver_en: Actually, I used to frown a lot before.
lines.en: Really? Your expression is much brighter now.

lines.beaver_en: So these days I try to smile often.
Your hair looks different too, Minho. Did you get a haircut?
lines.en: Yes, I got my hair cut yesterday.

lines.beaver: 정말 잘 어울려요. 사람들 시선이 가겠어요.
lines.beaver_en: It really suits you. People will be looking.
lines.beaver_roman: jeongmal jal eoullyeoyo. saramdeul siseoni gagesseoyo.
lines.en: My friend said it suits me, and it seems true.

lines.beaver: 그럼요. 민호 씨는 사람 처음 볼 때 뭘 제일 먼저 봐요?
lines.beaver_en: Of course. Minho, what do you notice first when you meet someone?
lines.beaver_roman: geureomyo. minho ssineun saram cheoeum bol ttae mwol jeil meonjeo bwayo?
lines.learner: 첫인상은 외모보다 눈빛이 중요한 것 같아요.
lines.en: I think the eyes matter more than looks for first impressions.
lines.roman: cheoninsangeun oemoboda nunbichi jungyohan geot gatayo.

lines.beaver_en: I agree. I should get going now. It was nice seeing you.
lines.learner: 저도요. 다음에 또 만나요, 지수 씨!
lines.en: Me too. Let's meet again, Jisu!
lines.roman: jeodoyo. daeume tto mannayo, jisu ssi!
